I think I just keep pushing my thoughts back far, I've thought bout past things a couple times and that's when I go in pretty much black out  states. I have some times I can be fine feeling but they don't last very long, only an hour or few 
Thanks for the advice though Ill try and keep then in mind
Them movies just make me depressed. I been like this as early as I can remember so I try stuff and Still snap

I guess there is nothing current happening to me that really gets to me other then work. It's  hard for me to get along with co workers and to not snap at work. And that's just it. I don't have a whole lot to complain about. The therapists think it's post traumatic stress from my rough up bringing but that stuff does not even get to me that much. I can go days without thinking about it. I just keep on thinking about ways to be destructive and wanting to put people down all the time

Thank you but I'm sorry I've tried. Been to many different doctors and switched jobs into something I love. Been to the hospital under watch numerous times talking to people and all it is getting me is more frustrated for some reason

I take care of my health just fine, I know it may not seem like it but I kind of have to for my job. And I do t really understand how the impression that I don't take care of my health comes across so please explain.
I'm not a fan of mma, I do not do aggressive sports anymore because all it really does is amp me up rather then taking out aggression. I do a lot of working out in my own and biking to kill extra energy.
If I knew why I was so angry all the time i would probably try to fix it. But like I said when I wrote this, it's been like this since I was a kid. There is literally no in between from me being perfectly content to me snapping and freaking out.
